query:
WITH doomed AS (
                SELECT channel_id, seq
                FROM comms_channel_change_log
                WHERE created_at < $1
                ORDER BY created_at, channel_id, seq
                LIMIT $2
            )
            DELETE FROM comms_channel_change_log log
            USING doomed
            WHERE log.channel_id = doomed.channel_id
              AND log.seq = doomed.seq
